name: Can I patch drywall myself or should I hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I patch drywall myself or should I hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: Minor surface cracks and nail holes under an inch wide can often be patched by a homeowner using spackle and a putty knife. However, professional repair is recommended if the hole exceeds a few inches, involves damaged framing, sits on a ceiling, or requires seamless texture matching. Inexperienced DIY patches frequently leave visible ridges, flashing paint marks, or mismatched textures that stand out in direct lighting. Hiring an experienced finish contractor ensures proper structural backing, smooth feathering, and a uniform paint finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY works for tiny nail holes, but professional repairs are best for large holes, ceiling damage, and textured walls requiring seamless paint blending.
